config.tlm_sincerely.chatbar.multi_targe: Allow one message to address several maids, e.g. '@Alice @Bob hello', or '@all hello' for every maid in range. When disabled only the legacy single-target '@name message' form is parsed

config.tlm_sincerely.chatbar.target_rang: How far away (in blocks, straight-line, same dimension) a maid can still hear you. Used to find the maids named by '@name' / '@all', by the /tlmchat and /tlmmemory maid selectors, and by the tell_maid and maid_move tools to find another maid (1-256)

config.tlm_sincerely.multi_task.force_br: Rebuild the maid Brain once when an automatically switched task remains available but has no work target for 60 ticks. Enabled by default; disable it if another add-on modifies maid AI and conflicts

config.tlm_sincerely.multi_task.minimum_: Minimum normal task hold time; experimental attack preemption bypasses this limit

config.tlm_sincerely.multi_task.path_che: Maximum reachability checks by all maids per server tick

config.tlm_sincerely.relay.enabled.toolt: Let a maid relay one sentence to another maid of yours and ask her to respond, when the player addressed several maids at once or explicitly asked for it. Requires the optional 'Maid Self-Talk' mod with its inter-chat switch enabled; when disabled the tool is not exposed to the model
config.tlm_sincerely.relay.cooldown_seco: How long the same pair of maids must wait before relaying to each other again, direction does not matter (0 = no cooldown)
config.tlm_sincerely.relay.max_per_minut: Maximum relays per minute across all maids of the same owner, to stop the model from ping-ponging (1-120)
config.tlm_sincerely.move.enabled.toolti: Let a maid carry out an order when the player asks her to come closer, move away, go somewhere, guard someone, stay where she is, go home or work around the clock, and cancel it again (the maid_move, maid_guard, maid_work_time and maid_cancel tools); when disabled none of these tools is exposed to the model
config.tlm_sincerely.move.default_durati: Orders last until the player cancels them by default; only when the player explicitly asks for a temporary order (the model passes temporary or duration_seconds) does an order end by itself. This is how long a temporary order lasts when no length is given; default 300 (5 minutes, 10-86400). Note the default used to be 600 and applied to every order; a value already stored in an old config file is not migrated
config.tlm_sincerely.move.max_duration_s: Upper bound of duration_seconds; longer requests are clamped to this value; default 3600 (1 hour, 10-86400). Note the default used to be 300; a value already stored in an old config file is not migrated
config.tlm_sincerely.move.max_active_per: Maximum movement orders active at the same time across all maids of one owner; further orders are rejected and reported to the model (1-64); permanent orders occupy a slot too
config.tlm_sincerely.move.allow_permanen: Allow orders without a time limit

Allow orders to last until the player cancels them (the default kind); when disabled every order is temporary: an order the player did not ask to be temporary only lasts the default duration, and the tool result tells the model to say so
config.tlm_sincerely.move.permanent_remi: Reminder interval for orders without a time limit (minutes)

How often an order without a time limit makes the maid say a reminder line to the player (0 disables reminders, 0-120). Orders now last until cancelled by default, so the default became 0 (off) to avoid nagging; a value already stored in an old config file (10) is not migrated. An order re-registered after a server restart restarts this timer
config.tlm_sincerely.move.teleport_fallb: Teleport when the way is blocked

When a maid is stuck and cannot walk to the destination, teleport her there (at most 3 times per order, at least 5 seconds apart) and say a line in chat on her behalf; when disabled the old behaviour stays: keep trying to walk and only write an INFO log, no teleport and no chat line
config.tlm_sincerely.move.teleport_max_d: When the maid-to-destination distance is larger than this the order is dropped (the maid says it is too far); only within this range is she teleported (8-256)
config.tlm_sincerely.move.force_work_sch: Force work time while an order is active

While a movement order is active, temporarily switch the maid's schedule to work-around-the-clock as long as she is not asleep, and restore the original schedule when the order ends (expired / cancelled / replaced). This lets a maid without a work position move and accept a work task at night. The work_time action exists to widen the schedule itself and is not affected by this switch. Note: changing the schedule yourself (maid GUI or the switch_schedule tool) is treated as taking over, so the schedule is not restored when the order ends
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.task_switc: When the player asks a maid (through the model) to switch to a work task while it is not her working time, switch her schedule to work-around-the-clock temporarily instead of answering 'not in work time', and restore it afterwards. Changing the schedule yourself (maid GUI or the switch_schedule tool) during overtime is treated as taking over and it is not restored
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.task_hold_: How long overtime started by a task switch lasts without a new instruction (seconds, 30-3600). Every new task switch restarts the timer; when it runs out (or the maid is switched to the idle task) her original schedule is restored. There is no reliable way to tell that every kind of task has run out of work, so this timer stands in for 'the work is done'
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.soft_cap_e: A maid who works overtime during the time she should be asleep gets tired. Only overtime while her original schedule says rest counts; overtime in her working or leisure time does not build up. She recovers fully after about 5 minutes without overtime. What happens when she is tired is decided by the treat and complain options below
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.soft_cap_s: How many seconds of overtime in her rest time a maid can take before she gets tired (real seconds, 30-3600)
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.complain_e: Complain when tired (master switch of fatigue)

Complaining comes first: a tired maid always speaks first - a complaint (and she keeps working) when treats are disabled, a request for a treat when they are enabled. Both lines are generated by the model from her personality; when it is unavailable, fails or is too slow a fixed fallback line is spoken, so you are always told. Turn this off and she never gets tired at all: no complaint, no request for a treat, never sent to rest, and no rest-time overtime lock-out
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.treat_enab: Ask owner for a treat when tired

When the cap is reached the maid asks her owner for a treat and walks over to them; a treat lets her keep going longer. If she gets none within the wait time (or the owner is offline / too far away) she stops working and goes to rest, and cannot be put on overtime again until her rest time is over. When disabled she only complains and keeps working
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.treats.too: Format 'namespace:item=seconds', e.g. minecraft:cake=300 means one cake lets her work 300 more seconds. Hand it to her with a right click while she asks, or put it in her backpack. Entries in any other format are ignored
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.eat_own_tr: Eat treats from own backpack first
When tired, if her own backpack holds an item from the treat list she eats it right away instead of asking
config.tlm_sincerely.overtime.treat_wait: How long a tired maid waits for a treat before she gives up and goes to rest (seconds, 10-600)
chat.tlm_sincerely.overtime.treat_hint: %s is tired and would like a treat (right-click her with one, or put it in her backpack): %s
config.tlm_sincerely.adventure.sleep_sta: The tick of the day at which the adventure schedule starts sleeping (0 = 06:00, 6000 = 12:00, 12000 = 18:00, 18000 = 00:00; the default 17000 is 23:00). The window may run past the end of the day. Changes apply the next time a maid refreshes her brain (switching schedule, re-entering the world)
config.tlm_sincerely.adventure.sleep_dur: How long the adventure schedule sleeps each day (1000 ticks = one hour, default 4000 = four hours, range 1000-20000). The rest of the day she works; there is no leisure time
config.tlm_sincerely.adventure.vanilla_b: When there is no maid bed nearby, a maid on the adventure schedule sleeps in the nearest unoccupied vanilla bed; a maid bed is always preferred when there is one
config.tlm_sincerely.reply.model_split_e: Ask the model to split replies

Adds a short instruction to the maid's system prompt asking the model to break its reply into a few short sentences, one per line, like messages in a chat app; each line is shown as its own chat line (keep "Show replies as separate lines" on). Off by default; independent of the pause marker below
config.tlm_sincerely.reply.pause_marker_: Tells the model it may write <等待> (or <wait>) between two sentences to pause there; the chat shows the part after it a moment later. The bubble and the voice still appear all at once, only the chat lines are staggered. Off by default. Whether or not this is on, markers in a reply are always removed and never appear in the bubble, the voice, the chat or the history
config.tlm_sincerely.reply.pause_seconds: How many seconds a pause marker without its own number holds the next part back (0.3-10)
config.tlm_sincerely.reply.pause_max_tot: The most the pauses of one reply may add up to (1-60 seconds); markers beyond it no longer delay the rest

task.tlm_sincerely.guard.desc:
Protects people from a guard list: the list is ordered by priority and each entry has its own condition (always, or only while their health is below some value).
When nobody on the list needs guarding she is an ordinary melee maid.
Talk to her to adjust the list, or ask her in chat to guard someone.
